hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Compute the total score for each student by summing assignment1 + assignment2 + assignment3.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Take maximum() and minimum() of the total scores across all students.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Subtract minimum() from maximum() to get difference_in_score.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    MAX(assignment1 + assignment2 + assignment3) - MIN(assignment1 + assignment2 + assignment3) AS difference_in_score 
FROM Scores;
```
